entities.summary: The Stockholm City Line is a railway tunnel beneath central Stockholm in Sweden which is used by the Stockholm commuter rail. The line is 7.4 kilometres (4.6 mi) long, double track and electrified. It has two stations: Stockholm City station, which is connected to Stockholm Central Station and located directly below T-Centralen metro station; and Stockholm Odenplan station which is also served by the Green Line of the Metro. The line and its stations opened on 10 July 2017.
